content: node:sqlite (built into Node.js since v22.5, Release Candidate/stability 1.2 as of Node 25.7+/26.x, fully stabilized in Node 26) requires zero npm install and no native compilation, ideal for a personal CLI. better-sqlite3 (npm v12.11.1, 7.5M weekly downloads) is faster and has richer features (nested transactions, extensions) but requires native bindings via node-gyp, which can break on some environments. For a single-user local CLI on a dev machine already running Node 26, node:sqlite avoids a native-dependency footprint; better-sqlite3 is the fallback if node:sqlite API proves too limited (no transaction() helper, sync-only).
